test_title: NFR-BT-005: valid device record loads with ID, display name and 6-digit passkey
preconditions: Loader available; fixture with one valid device
test_data: {id: DEV-001; name: Test Phone A; passkey: 123456}
steps: 1. Create fixture with the single device; 2. Load fixture; 3. Read the loaded device
expected_result: Device loaded; ID DEV-001, display name Test Phone A and passkey 123456 are all present and unchanged
notes: ST-01.1 / WIPC-37 AC1; ST-01.1.1 / WIPC-45; SRS 4 item 2; Q-03; passkey length 6 (valid boundary)

test_title: NFR-BT-005: fixture loads from test-data/bluetooth-devices.json
preconditions: File test-data/bluetooth-devices.json exists with valid synthetic devices
steps: 1. Load the fixture test-data/bluetooth-devices.json; 2. Read returned devices
expected_result: Devices from test-data/bluetooth-devices.json are loaded; all devices in the file are returned
notes: ST-01.1 / WIPC-37 AC2; ST-01.1.2 / WIPC-47; SRS 4 item 1

test_title: NFR-BT-005: shipped fixture file contains at least 7 devices
steps: 1. Load the shipped fixture; 2. Count devices
expected_result: At least 7 devices loaded (more than the 5-device pairing limit)
notes: ST-01.1 / WIPC-37 AC2; ST-01.1.2 / WIPC-47; SRS 4 items 1 and 4; count is the boundary check; a 6-device fixture is not loader-testable (content of the shipped file, not loader behaviour)

test_title: NFR-BT-005: fixture with 8 devices loads all 8
steps: 1. Load the 8-device fixture; 2. Count returned devices
expected_result: 8 devices returned; none dropped or altered
notes: ST-01.1 / WIPC-37 AC2; ST-01.1.2 / WIPC-47; inference from SRS 4 item 4: the 5-device limit applies to paired devices, not to the fixture

test_title: NFR-BT-005: every device in the shipped fixture is valid
steps: 1. Load the shipped fixture; 2. Check each device for ID, display name and 6-digit numeric passkey
expected_result: Every device has a device ID, a display name and a 6-digit numeric passkey
notes: ST-01.1 / WIPC-37 AC1; ST-01.1.2 / WIPC-47; SRS 4 item 2; Q-03

test_title: NFR-BT-005: device IDs in the shipped fixture are unique
steps: 1. Load the shipped fixture; 2. Compare all device IDs
expected_result: No device ID occurs more than once; load is accepted
notes: ST-01.1 / WIPC-37 AC1 and AC3; SRS 4 item 2

test_title: NFR-BT-005: shipped fixture holds synthetic data only
steps: 1. Load the shipped fixture; 2. Inspect every device ID, display name and passkey
expected_result: Every device ID, display name and passkey is a synthetic placeholder; none is a real device identifier or personal data
notes: ST-01.1 / WIPC-37 AC1 (synthetic); AGENTS.md sensitive data rule; no ID or name pattern asserted (not defined by an AC); passkey format is covered by TC-NFR-005-05

test_title: NFR-BT-005: two entries with the same device ID rejected
steps: 1. Load fixture with two entries with id DEV-001
expected_result: Duplicate device ID is rejected on load
notes: ST-01.1 / WIPC-37 AC3; ST-01.1.3 / WIPC-43; duplicate count 2 (invalid boundary); whole-fixture vs entry-level rejection not specified (clarification point); loader error content not specified (clarification point)

test_title: NFR-BT-005: duplicate ID with different name and passkey still rejected
test_data: {id: DEV-001; name: Test Phone A; passkey: 123456}; {id: DEV-001; name: Test Phone B; passkey: 654321}
steps: 1. Load fixture with both entries
expected_result: Duplicate device ID is rejected on load
notes: ST-01.1 / WIPC-37 AC3; ST-01.1.3 / WIPC-43; whole-fixture vs entry-level rejection not specified (clarification point); loader error content not specified (clarification point)

test_title: NFR-BT-005: non-adjacent duplicate ID in a 7-entry fixture rejected
test_data: 7 entries DEV-001..DEV-006 plus a second DEV-002 as 7th entry
steps: 1. Load the fixture
expected_result: Duplicate device ID is rejected on load
notes: ST-01.1 / WIPC-37 AC3; ST-01.1.3 / WIPC-43; whole-fixture vs entry-level rejection not specified (clarification point), so no device-list assertion; loader error content not specified (clarification point)

test_title: DOC-CAPL-001: every built-in function called in the template has a citation line
preconditions: File tests/capl/capl_script_template.can exists; pytest parser strips comments and string literals before scanning code
steps: 1. Read the template; 2. Extract the header citation lines; 3. Extract identifiers called as functions in the code outside the header comment, strings and C keywords; 4. Compare the two sets
expected_result: Each called built-in (write, setTimer) has at least one citation line; no called built-in is missing a citation
notes: ST-09.1 / WIPC-48 AC2; SRS 6.1 DOC-CAPL-001; Q-49 (C keywords and operators excluded); whether event headers (on start, on timer) and the msTimer type need citations is not defined (clarification point), so they are not asserted

test_title: DOC-CAPL-001: template copy with an uncited built-in call is flagged
preconditions: Temp copy of the template with a call to a third built-in (for example output) added and no citation line for it
test_data: Copy of tests/capl/capl_script_template.can plus a call to output(); no citation line for output
steps: 1. Create the temp copy with the added call; 2. Run the citation check on the copy
expected_result: Check fails and reports output as a built-in without a citation; the original template is not modified
notes: ST-09.1 / WIPC-48 AC2; SRS 6.1 DOC-CAPL-001; Q-49; negative path proves the check can fail

test_title: DOC-CAPL-001: template citation lines follow the 4-field format
test_data: tests/capl/capl_script_template.can; format: function | source | entry title or ID | CANoe version checked
steps: 1. Read the header citation lines for write and setTimer; 2. Split each line on |; 3. Check the field count and that no field is empty
expected_result: Each citation line has 4 non-empty fields: function, source, entry title or ID, CANoe version checked
notes: ST-09.1 / WIPC-48 AC2; SRS 6.1 DOC-CAPL-001 (Vector help or KB entry cited); field layout taken from the template Format line

test_title: DOC-CAPL-001: citation line with empty entry title is flagged
preconditions: Temp copy of the template where the write citation has an empty entry title field
test_data: Citation line: write | CANoe offline CAPL function reference |  | CANoe 17 SP3
steps: 1. Create the temp copy with the empty entry title; 2. Run the citation check on the copy
expected_result: Check fails for write: citation does not identify a Vector help or KB entry
notes: ST-09.1 / WIPC-48 AC2; SRS 6.1 DOC-CAPL-001 (entry must be cited)

test_title: DOC-CAPL-001: C-style constructs need no citation
preconditions: Temp copy of the template with if, for, while and switch statements added and no citation for them
test_data: Copy of the template with if, for, while, switch added
steps: 1. Create the temp copy; 2. Run the citation check on the copy
expected_result: Check passes; if, for, while and switch are not reported as uncited functions
notes: ST-09.1 / WIPC-48 AC2; SRS 6.1 DOC-CAPL-001 (non-C-style constructs only); Q-49 (C keywords excluded)

test_title: DOC-CAPL-001: function name inside a string or comment is not treated as a call
preconditions: Temp copy of the template where the word output appears only in a string literal and in a comment
test_data: Copy of the template with write("call output later") and a comment mentioning output
steps: 1. Create the temp copy; 2. Run the citation check on the copy
expected_result: Check passes; output is not reported as an uncited function
notes: ST-09.1 / WIPC-48 AC2; SRS 6.1 DOC-CAPL-001 (functions it uses); inference: only calls count as use

test_title: DOC-CAPL-001: template has a citation section in the header comment
steps: 1. Read the header comment block before the variables section; 2. Look for the Citations heading naming DOC-CAPL-001, DOC-CAPL-002 and DOC-CAPL-003
expected_result: The header comment contains a Citations section with at least one citation line; the section precedes the variables block
notes: ST-09.1 / WIPC-48 AC2; SRS 6.1

test_title: DOC-CAPL-002: header records the CANoe version as CANoe 17 SP3
steps: 1. Read the header comment block; 2. Find the CANoe version field; 3. Read its value
expected_result: Header has a CANoe version field with value CANoe 17 SP3
notes: ST-09.1 / WIPC-48 AC1; SRS 6.1 DOC-CAPL-002; Q-50 (baseline CANoe 17 SP3)

test_title: DOC-CAPL-002: version value matches the pattern CANoe <major> SP<n>
steps: 1. Read the CANoe version value; 2. Match it against the pattern
expected_result: Value matches the pattern CANoe <digits> SP<digits> and contains a major version number
notes: ST-09.1 / WIPC-48 AC1; SRS 6.1 DOC-CAPL-002 (example CANoe 17 SP3); pattern derived from the SRS example only; whether a value without a service pack (CANoe 17) is accepted is not defined (clarification point)

test_title: DOC-CAPL-002: template copy without a CANoe version field is flagged
preconditions: Temp copy of the template with the CANoe version line removed
test_data: Copy of tests/capl/capl_script_template.can without the CANoe version line
steps: 1. Create the temp copy; 2. Run the version check on the copy
expected_result: Check fails: header has no CANoe version
notes: ST-09.1 / WIPC-48 AC1; SRS 6.1 DOC-CAPL-002

test_title: DOC-CAPL-002: placeholder or empty version value is flagged
preconditions: Temp copies of the template with the version value set to an empty string, <version> and CANoe (no number)
steps: 1. For each value create the temp copy; 2. Run the version check on each copy
expected_result: Check fails for each copy: no concrete CANoe version recorded
notes: ST-09.1 / WIPC-48 AC1; SRS 6.1 DOC-CAPL-002 (version must be recorded)

test_title: DOC-CAPL-002: version is recorded once in the header
steps: 1. Count CANoe version fields in the file; 2. Check that the field lies in the header comment block before the variables section
expected_result: Exactly one CANoe version field exists and it is in the header comment block
notes: ST-09.1 / WIPC-48 AC1; SRS 6.1 DOC-CAPL-002; Q-50 (version recorded once in the script header)

test_title: DOC-CAPL-002: version checked in each citation line is present
steps: 1. Read the citation lines; 2. Read the last field of each line; 3. Compare with the header CANoe version
expected_result: Each citation line has a CANoe version in its last field and it equals the header version (CANoe 17 SP3)
notes: ST-09.1 / WIPC-48 AC1 and AC2; SRS 6.1 DOC-CAPL-002 (function availability varies by version); last field comes from the template Format line; behaviour when a citation version differs from the header is not defined (clarification point), so no mismatch case

test_title: DOC-CAPL-003: every template citation uses an accepted Vector source
test_data: tests/capl/capl_script_template.can; accepted sources: help.vector.com, kb.vector.com, vector.com application note, offline CAPL function reference
steps: 1. Read the source field of every citation line; 2. Match each against the accepted sources
expected_result: Every citation source is one of the four accepted sources (write and setTimer cite the CANoe offline CAPL function reference)
notes: ST-09.1 / WIPC-48 AC3; SRS 6.1 DOC-CAPL-003; Q-51 (four named sources)

test_title: DOC-CAPL-003: function cited only by a forum is flagged
preconditions: Temp copy of the template where the setTimer citation source is a forum
test_data: Citation line: setTimer | Vector forum thread | Timer question | CANoe 17 SP3
steps: 1. Create the temp copy; 2. Run the source check on the copy
expected_result: Check fails: setTimer has a forum as its only source
notes: ST-09.1 / WIPC-48 AC3; SRS 6.1 DOC-CAPL-003; Q-51

test_title: DOC-CAPL-003: function cited only by a blog is flagged
preconditions: Temp copy of the template where the write citation source is a blog
test_data: Citation line: write | CAPL tips blog | Printing from CAPL | CANoe 17 SP3
steps: 1. Create the temp copy; 2. Run the source check on the copy
expected_result: Check fails: write has a blog as its only source
notes: ST-09.1 / WIPC-48 AC3; SRS 6.1 DOC-CAPL-003; Q-51

test_title: DOC-CAPL-003: forum plus a Vector source is accepted
preconditions: Temp copy of the template where write has two citation lines: the CANoe offline CAPL function reference and a forum
test_data: Citation lines for write: offline CAPL function reference; forum thread
steps: 1. Create the temp copy; 2. Run the source check on the copy
expected_result: Check passes: the forum is not the sole reference for write
notes: ST-09.1 / WIPC-48 AC3; SRS 6.1 DOC-CAPL-003 (not the sole reference); decision table row: Vector source yes, forum yes; assumes several citation lines per function are allowed (template shows one line per function, clarification point)

test_title: DOC-CAPL-003: forum plus blog without a Vector source is flagged
preconditions: Temp copy of the template where setTimer has two citation lines: a forum and a blog
test_data: Citation lines for setTimer: forum thread; blog post
steps: 1. Create the temp copy; 2. Run the source check on the copy
expected_result: Check fails: setTimer has no accepted Vector source
notes: ST-09.1 / WIPC-48 AC3; SRS 6.1 DOC-CAPL-003; decision table row: Vector source no, forum yes, blog yes; Q-51

test_title: DOC-CAPL-003: source outside the four accepted sources is flagged
preconditions: Temp copy of the template where write is cited only to a third-party site that is not one of the four accepted sources
test_data: Citation line: write | Third-party tutorial site | Write intro | CANoe 17 SP3
steps: 1. Create the temp copy; 2. Run the source check on the copy
expected_result: Check fails: the source is not one of the four accepted sources
notes: ST-09.1 / WIPC-48 AC3; Q-51 (acceptable sources are the four named in section 6.1); a vector.com blog page is not covered by the SRS (clarification point)

test_title: DOC-CAPL-003: template states that a forum or blog is never the sole source
steps: 1. Read the header comment block; 2. Search the citation guidance for the forum and blog rule
expected_result: Header guidance states that a forum or blog is never the sole source and lists the accepted Vector sources
notes: ST-09.1 / WIPC-48 AC3; SRS 6.1 DOC-CAPL-003; Q-51

test_title: NFR-BT-005: template header has Trace field naming NFR-BT-005
steps: 1. Read the header comment block; 2. Find the Trace field; 3. Check that its example lists NFR-BT-005
expected_result: Header has a Trace field whose guidance includes NFR-BT-005, the parent of DOC-CAPL-001..003
notes: ST-09.1 / WIPC-48; SRS 6.1 (supplements NFR-BT-005); Q-48

test_title: NFR-BT-005: template header has OQ dependency field defaulting to none
steps: 1. Read the header comment block; 2. Find the OQ dependency field; 3. Read its value
expected_result: Header has an OQ dependency field with value none and guidance that a dependent test is Blocked and linked to its question
notes: ST-09.1 / WIPC-48; SRS 6.1 last paragraph (CAPL tests depending on OQ-01..OQ-08 are blocked); no OQ answer assumed
